body:
Triage: lands in `examples/app-showcase` ⇒ routed `domain:services`. Graded `Bug` · `priority:p3`.

Landing point read on `origin/main` at 15:18Z rather than taken from the title: the showcase is `examples/app-showcase`, and the file the repair edits is `examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts` (plus the app's nav declarations for any object gated instead of granted).

**Why `domain:services` and not `devx`.** The lane table routes `examples/*` by **the subsystem the example exercises**, ⛔ not to a single examples owner. What is broken here is the permission-set model: seven nav entries reference objects no permission set grants read on, and `showcase_field_zoo` is a detail object with no object-level CRUD grant beside its master. Deciding **grant read versus gate the nav entry**, per object, is a judgement about the permission and sharing semantics — the `domain:services` lane owns those (`plugin-security` / `plugin-sharing` folded in on 2026-08-19). A seat without that model would be guessing on eight independent calls.

`Bug` by the mechanical boundary test: nothing widens: a nav entry that renders and then fails on open is declared-not-delivered, and the repair restores agreement.

`priority:p3` — the card claims no severity and is right not to. It is the reference app rather than the product, the build stays green (advisory tier), and every warning ships with its own prescription. ⚠️ The reason it is not p4-and-forget is the second-order cost the card names: **33 advisory warnings on every showcase build is where the next real one goes to hide.**

**Scope is fixed by the card and worth keeping**: read the showcase permission sets, decide per object, and ⛔ **do not widen into the other advisory classes in the same log**. The instrument is the `objectstack validate` / showcase-build warning count dropping by exactly the number of entries fixed — a countable before/after, so the PR can prove it rather than assert it.

⚠️ Premise age: the reading is from PR #14449's CI log at head `e9c424e7` (2026-09-02), corroborated by that dev's before/after `objectstack validate` run showing 33 advisory warnings on both trees. ⛔ Re-run the validate before editing — the count is the acceptance instrument, so a stale baseline makes the PR unprovable.
